name: KopperDigger
description: Let Claude and other AI assistants design schematics and PCBs in KiCad via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
description_full:
KopperDigger is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants such as Claude a complete set of KiCad design tools: schematic editing, PCB layout, routing with Freerouting, library management, ERC/DRC, design review audits, and manufacturing exports. Its 232 tools are organized into toolsets that are loaded on demand, so the assistant only sees the tools it currently needs.

The package bundles the native KopperDigger server (written in Rust) for Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux x86_64; the plugin picks the right one at startup. The PCB editor toolbar button opens a settings dialog to configure and start the server. Connect your MCP client (for example Claude Desktop or Claude Code) to the server binary shown there.

Optional part-sourcing tools query public LCSC/JLCPCB part data only when you ask the assistant to use them.

KopperDigger is free software under the GNU AGPL v3 (AGPL-3.0-only), a community fork of the last open-source release of Konnect by mixelpixx and contributors.
